title: CR-PAY-013 — Full invoicing (delete)
preconds: Permissions (counted): Customer: View; Part Sales V+E+D, Invoicing V+E+D, AP/AR. Auto-gate forced ON (not counted): See Fin. View Mode: Full unless noted. All other permissions OFF.
steps:
1. Create a custom role with the permissions listed in Preconditions; leave all others OFF.
  2. Assign the role to a test user and log in.
  3. Exercise each capability in Expected Result and confirm it succeeds (and that gated pricing is hidden where noted).
expected:
User CAN: Process payments; deposits; send to terminal; delete payments (incl customer payments); void transactions; 

Risk / Rationale: Positive capability check — confirms this combination grants exactly the listed actions and nothing gated leaks. See Flag / Note.
Spec Ref: §1h
Flag / Note: \u26a0 Delete force-enables AP/AR (gate #2) + See Financial (gate #1)
